items.title: Stop short-term/holiday rental and resume permanent residential use
items.quote: Wir geben Ihnen daher auf, die Vermietung an wechselnde Gäste zu beenden und die Wohnung wieder zum dauerhaften Wohnen zu nutzen oder zu vermieten.
items.computation: The order does not state a specific calendar date or period by which the change of use must be completed; it appears to take effect upon receipt of the order. No deadline can be computed from the text.

items.title: File Widerspruch against the Anordnung
items.quote: Ihr Widerspruch muss spätestens einen Monat nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids beim Bezirksamt Beispielbüttel, Grindelberg 62, 20144 Hamburg, eingehen – schriftlich, elektronisch mit qualifizierter Signatur oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 2026-04-02, sent by ordinary post. Under §41(2) sentence 1 VwVfG (applicable in Hamburg via HmbVwVfG), a letter mailed domestically is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the 3rd day after mailing: 02.04.2026 + 3 days = 05.04.2026, a Sunday. Under §41(2) sentence 2 VwVfG, if that 3rd day falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the next business day counts as the Bekanntgabe date, i.e. Monday 06.04.2026. The one-month period runs per §31 HmbVwVfG in conjunction with §§187(1), 188(2) BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe is not counted (period starts 07.04.2026); it ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day (06.05.2026), a Wednesday and not a Hamburg public holiday, so no further shift applies. Deadline for receipt of the Widerspruch by the authority: 2026-05-06.

data.sender_name: Freie und Hansestadt Hamburg – Bezirksamt Beispielbüttel, Fachamt Wohnraumschutz
warnings: The order to stop the holiday-let use and return the flat to permanent residential use has no explicit deadline in the letter; it appears to apply immediately upon receipt, so the recipient should not assume any grace period beyond the Widerspruch deadline.

The letter warns that non-compliance can lead to a Zwangsgeld (coercive fine), but no amount or further deadline for compliance is specified — this should be clarified with the authority (Herr Petersen, Raum 3.12) if in doubt.
